statements.attributed: The <rA> average radius of the A-sublattice affects the values of both the <B-O> average bond length and the <B-O-B> average bond angle
statements.quote: The <rA> average radius of the A-sublattice of perovskite structure affects the values of both the <B-O> average bond length and the <B-O-B> average bond angle .

statements.attributed: A decrease in the <rA> average radius of the A-sublattice increases the distortions of the unit cell and weakens the intensity of the indirect super-exchange interactions
statements.quote: A decrease in the <rA> average radius of the A-sublattice increases the distortions of the unit cell and weakens the intensity of the indirect super-exchange interactions, which leads to a decrease in the <B-O-B> average bond angle and an increase in the <B-O> average bond length .
